summary: Cleanest of the three Bank datasets by data completeness (no null balances, no ambiguous debit/credit rows) and the only one with real channel diversity. Confirmed via direct function execution: 0 rejected rows, 0 zero-amount rows post-fix (previously 2,496 credit-side rows were silently zeroed by the now-fixed _CREDIT_KEYWORDS bug).
key_findings: 8 source columns present, identical shape to scanwick_bank_savings_clean.csv: trans_date, value_date, description, debit, credit, balance, channel, transaction_reference.
balance is fully populated (0 nulls) -- best of the three files for balance-integrity precision.
No rows with both debit and credit populated (0 ambiguous rows, unlike dataset_01's one ambiguous row).
channel has real diversity (4 distinct values: Mobile, WEB, USSD, POS) -- the file to use later for payment-mode/channel diagnostics.
value_date, channel, and transaction_reference are real, clean columns not currently captured by ingestion (low severity, same gap as dataset_02).
At 8,158 rows this is the largest of the three real Bank files -- reasonable as the volume test case for Prompt 2.
No duplicate column headers; no duplicate transaction_reference values.
Credit-column keyword-collision bug (fixed prior to this run) confirmed resolved for this file: 0 zero-amount rows now vs. 2,496 before the fix -- the largest single fix-impact of the three files.
verdict: PASS. Bank Test Prompt 2 (Ingestion) can proceed immediately. No follow-ups beyond the shared value_date/channel/transaction_reference non-capture note already logged against dataset_02.
